instruction: Write a workflow that runs only when pushes target the main or develop branches.
output:
name: branch-push
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make ci

instruction: Trigger a workflow on pull requests targeting main for the opened, synchronize, and reopened actions.
output:
name: pr-ci
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test

instruction: Schedule a workflow to run nightly at 02:30 UTC with a cron expression.
output:
name: nightly
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 2 * * *'
jobs:
  nightly:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python scripts/nightly_report.py

instruction: Add a workflow_dispatch trigger with a choice input for the target environment.
output:
name: manual-run
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: Target environment
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Deploying to ${{ inputs.environment }}"

instruction: Run the workflow whenever a GitHub release is published.
output:
name: release
on:
  release:
    types: [published]
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Release ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }} published"

instruction: Trigger a workflow on version tags matching the v* pattern.
output:
name: tag-build
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "Building tag ${{ github.ref_name }}"

instruction: Limit a workflow to runs where files under src/ or package.json changed.
output:
name: src-paths
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'package.json'
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci && npm run build

instruction: Ignore documentation-only changes by excluding docs/** and markdown files from push triggers.
output:
name: docs-ignored
on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '**/*.md'
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test

instruction: Trigger a workflow with repository_dispatch and check out the ref from the client payload.
output:
name: repo-dispatch
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [build-triggered]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref }}
      - run: make build

instruction: Run a workflow when an issue is opened or labeled.
output:
name: issue-triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, labeled]
jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Issue ${{ github.event.issue.number }} was ${{ github.event.action }}"

instruction: Start a workflow when a comment containing the deploy command is created on an issue.
output:
name: comment-trigger
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
jobs:
  respond:
    if: ${{ contains(github.event.comment.body, '/deploy') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Deploy requested in comment"

instruction: Run a workflow after the CI workflow on the main branch completes successfully.
output:
name: after-ci
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    branches: [main]
    types: [completed]
jobs:
  post:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "CI finished successfully"

instruction: Allow both a weekly cron schedule and manual workflow_dispatch for the same job.
output:
name: weekly-manual
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  weekly:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python scripts/weekly_digest.py

instruction: Filter pull request runs with paths so only changes under app/ or api/ trigger tests.
output:
name: pr-paths
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'api/**'
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pytest -q

instruction: Run only for pushes that do not touch the experimental branch namespace.
output:
name: ignore-experimental
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - 'experimental/**'
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build

instruction: Create a workflow_dispatch trigger with string, boolean, and number inputs used later by the job.
output:
name: typed-inputs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: Git ref to build
        required: true
        type: string
        default: main
      run_migration:
        description: Run database migration
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      workers:
        description: Number of workers
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 2
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
      - run: echo "migration=${{ inputs.run_migration }} workers=${{ inputs.workers }}"

instruction: Trigger a workflow when a discussion is created in the repository.
output:
name: discussion
on:
  discussion:
    types: [created]
jobs:
  acknowledge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo "New discussion: ${{ github.event.discussion.title }}"

instruction: Run a workflow when a package is published to the GitHub Container Registry.
output:
name: package-published
on:
  registry_packages:
    types: [published]
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Package ${{ github.event.registry_package.name }} published"

instruction: Add a merge_group trigger so the workflow runs for merge queue validation.
output:
name: merge-queue
on:
  merge_group:
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make validate

instruction: Run a workflow twice daily on cron and also on manual dispatch for emergency runs.
output:
name: twice-daily
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6,18 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python scripts/sync_upstream.py
